title: Use Pixverse C1 or Vidu instead of Seedance 2 for morphing/reshaping character…
content: Use Pixverse C1 or Vidu instead of Seedance 2 for morphing/reshaping character transformations (e.g., werewolf transformation clips).
tips: Use Pixverse C1 or Vidu instead of Seedance 2 for morphing/reshaping character transformations (e.g., werewolf transformation clips).

es.content: Usa Pixverse C1 o Vidu en lugar de Seedance 2 para morphing/reshaping de transformaciones de personajes (por ejemplo, clips de transformación en hombre lobo).

fr.content: Utilisez Pixverse C1 ou Vidu à la place de Seedance 2 pour les transformations de morphing/reshaping de personnages (par exemple, des clips de transformation en loup-garou).

ja.content: キャラクターの変身・形状変化（例：狼男への変身クリップ）には、Seedance 2 の代わりに Pixverse C1 または Vidu を使用してください。

ko.content: 형태 변형/재형성 캐릭터 변신(예: 늑대인간 변신 클립)에는 Seedance 2 대신 Pixverse C1 또는 Vidu를 사용하세요.

pt.content: Use Pixverse C1 ou Vidu em vez de Seedance 2 para morphing/transformações de personagens com reshaping (por exemplo, clipes de transformação em lobisomem).

zh.content: 对于角色变形/重塑类转化（例如狼人变身片段），请使用 Pixverse C1 或 Vidu，而不是 Seedance 2。
